Subject: Internal: QuantifAI routing matrix + invoice generation approach (QFA renewal)

Irene / Ben — moving this thread internal to confirm operations. Summary of customer requirements:
- Usage invoices May–July reference PO-0043 and go to billing@quantifai.com (Net60)
- Commitment/seat invoices go to ap-payables@quantifai-pay.com (Net30) with separate PO to be issued for Aug–Sep
- Finance would prefer a single PDF with both lines, delivered to both recipients; fallback acceptable: single invoice number but two PDFs with identical invoice numbers and appropriate recipients

Proposed approach (I'd like Irene to confirm feasibility):
1) Create invoice #RDW-2027-QFA-0001 for May with two line items (commitment + pro-rata usage). Generate master PDF.
2) Use billing ops to email master PDF to both addresses but mark primary recipient (billing@quantifai.com) in the accounting metadata so our AR system posts Net60 for usage items and Net30 for commitment lines via internal cost allocation tags.
3) Record PO-0043 as the reference for usage lines only. Create a separate PO field for commitment in the invoice metadata to accept the future Treasury PO when it arrives.

Irene: can you confirm we can apply differential net terms to line items within the same invoice in our AR system? If not, suggest we split into two invoices with same invoice number and mirrored metadata.

Ben: please update the HubSpot deal RDW-2027-QFA-0422 with mapping and let Legal know we might require an invoice copy to both emails (for audit trail).

Thanks — Tessa
